name: @nimblebraininc/agentreadycrm
description: A CRM for AI agents: organizations, contacts, interactions, deals, signals and proof points, kept in one SQLite file on your own machine. No account, no cloud service.

database_path.title: Database file
database_path.description: Where your CRM is stored. Leave empty for the default: crm.db in your user data directory. Keep it on a local disk, not a network share.

tools.name: find_or_create_organization
tools.description: Find an organization by domain (else name), or create it. Repeating it converges; a match fills only empty fields.

tools.name: find_or_create_contact
tools.description: Find a contact by email (else name and organization), or create it, wiring it to its organization. Repeating it converges.

tools.name: import_organizations
tools.description: Find or create up to 500 organizations from a list in one call, each as find_or_create_organization would.

tools.name: import_contacts
tools.description: Find or create up to 500 contacts from a list in one call, each as find_or_create_contact would.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Change a contact's fields, custom fields, external references or research dossier; only what is passed changes.

tools.name: merge_contacts
tools.description: Merge a duplicate contact into the one to keep, moving its interactions, signals and deals and filling empty fields, after the user confirms.

tools.name: merge_organizations
tools.description: Merge a duplicate organization into the one to keep, moving its contacts, interactions, deals, evidence and references, after the user confirms.

tools.name: archive_contact
tools.description: Hide a contact from default views, or restore it; nothing is deleted.

tools.name: archive_organization
tools.description: Hide an organization from default views, or restore it; nothing is deleted.

tools.name: delete_contact
tools.description: Delete a contact and what exists only for it, so no read finds it again, after the user confirms.

tools.name: delete_organization
tools.description: Delete an organization and what exists only for it, so no read finds it again, after the user confirms.

tools.name: update_organization
tools.description: Change an organization's fields, custom fields, external references or research dossier; only what is passed changes.

tools.name: log_interaction
tools.description: Record a meeting, email, call, note or research touch with a contact, optionally against a deal.

tools.name: get_pipeline
tools.description: Read the deal pipeline: its stages in order with each stage's deals, value and weighted value, and the totals.

tools.name: define_pipeline_stage
tools.description: Add a stage to the deal pipeline. An existing key is left as it is.

tools.name: update_pipeline_stage
tools.description: Change a pipeline stage's label, order, default probability or outcome.

tools.name: define_field
tools.description: Define a custom field on contacts, organizations or deals so it can be set, filtered and shown as a column.

tools.name: update_field
tools.description: Retire, restore or edit a custom field: its label, description, unused options, range or default column.

tools.name: list_fields
tools.description: List the core and custom fields of contacts, organizations and deals, with their types, options and meaning.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Read one contact with its counts, newest interactions and external references.

tools.name: resolve_external_refs
tools.description: Say which of a batch of other systems' references this workspace already holds, and on which records.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Read one organization with its counts, newest interactions and external references.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts by free-text query, filter on any field, sort and columns, a page at a time.

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.description: List organizations by free-text query, filter on any field, sort and columns, a page at a time.

tools.name: count_records
tools.description: Count contacts, organizations or deals by one field's values, under an optional filter.

tools.name: list_interactions
tools.description: List one contact's, organization's or deal's interactions, newest first, a page at a time.

tools.name: link_similar_organizations
tools.description: Save a similar-companies result as lookalikes of an organization; new ones stay discovered until promoted.

tools.name: promote_organization
tools.description: Promote a discovered lookalike to active so it appears in the default organization views.

tools.name: list_similar_organizations
tools.description: List an organization's linked lookalikes with their similarity scores.

tools.name: create_opportunity
tools.description: Create a deal on an account or contact. Every call creates one unless an idempotency_key repeats.

tools.name: update_opportunity
tools.description: Change a deal's fields, custom fields or research dossier; the stage moves with move_opportunity.

tools.name: move_opportunity
tools.description: Move a deal to another pipeline stage, stamping or clearing its close time.

tools.name: get_opportunity
tools.description: Read one deal with its counts and newest interactions.

tools.name: list_opportunities
tools.description: List deals by free-text query, filter on any field, sort and columns, a page at a time. Open deals unless asked.

tools.name: list_signal_types
tools.description: List the kinds of fact this workspace records about an account, with how many active signals each holds.

tools.name: define_signal_type
tools.description: Add a signal type to the workspace's vocabulary. An existing key is left as it is.

tools.name: update_signal_type
tools.description: Change a signal type's label or description.

tools.name: record_signal
tools.description: Record one fact about an organization with the verbatim quote that proves it and the URL it came from.

tools.name: withdraw_signal
tools.description: Withdraw a signal that turned out wrong or stale; it stays on record and leaves the default reads.

tools.name: update_signal
tools.description: Change whom a signal is evidence for: add a purpose, or remove one filed by mistake.

tools.name: get_signal
tools.description: Read one signal: its claim, the verbatim quote, and where and when it came from.

tools.name: list_signals
tools.description: List recorded signals newest first, or the ones changed since a mark.

tools.name: record_proof_point
tools.description: Record a citable claim about our own work, with whether anyone has attested it.

tools.name: verify_proof_point
tools.description: Attest a proof point as verified, unverified or a placeholder, naming who made the call.

tools.name: get_proof_point
tools.description: Read one proof point: its claim, metric and verification.

tools.name: list_proof_points
tools.description: List recorded proof points newest first, filtered by client or verification.
